selection.score_method: Total probability of fault mechanisms in Stim's approximate detector error model (approximate_disjoint_errors=True) of the relabelled circuit lowered with the Nove hardware noise model: the expected number of detector-visible faults per shot.
selection.tie_break_rule: Scores are rounded to 12 significant digits; the lowest rounded score wins and ties go to the lexicographically smallest mapping (circuit qubit order).
